verdict.rationale: Superpowers isolates work in an automatically created git worktree so parallel tasks don't clobber the source branch. Its workflow also stops for a human before destructive or irreversible actions and refuses to force-remove worktrees holding uncommitted work. That is code-level isolation, not a true test sandbox separated from production data. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test environment, isolation of data or services (not just source code), guarantees that tests never reach production systems, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
